Leah Torres: Heads-up — NorthBridge (renewal ~9 days) dropped to health_score=49. Usage cratered last month and trial seats not adopted. Thinking we should launch a 7-day rapid-rescue sprint instead of immediate discount.

cs-bot: Auto: renewal_date=2026-04-19, health_score=49, last_7d_api_calls=420 (down 62%).

Ethan Wu: Oof. Do we have cause? Product gap or enablement?

Leah Torres: Root causes: 1) rollout stalled — feature-flag mismatch; 2) engineering couldn't validate token limits; 3) CSM hasn't captured feedback from PMs.

Priya Desai: Proposed play: "rapid-rescue sprint" — 4 touchpoints over 7 days: kickoff, SE pairing, production smoke, wrap + feedback capture. Tie a $3k usage voucher to completion. No blanket discount.

Mark Reynolds: Agree on voucher vs discount. Finance prefers voucher conditioning (milestone-based). Also request a short amendment: 2-month partial recommit if they take voucher.

Ethan Wu: Add metric: onboard 3 active users + run 1 prod batch within 10 days. If not met, escalate to AE for downgrade conversation.

Leah Torres: I'll book kickoff with their PM and ops lead today. @Priya can you lead SE pairing? Prefer pairing Tue/Wed.

Priya Desai: I can do Wed 11am PT. Will prepare a tiny runbook and survey to capture blockers.

Leah Torres: Runbook skeleton (to paste in invite):
```
- Confirm admin access + env name
- Feature flag state: feature_x = enabled for staging
- Test payload sample (<=5MB)
- Expected throughput for smoke run
- PM priority list (top 2 blockers)
```

Mark Reynolds: I'll draft voucher T&C language: milestone = successful smoke run + signed acceptance email.

cs-bot: Note created task NB-rescue-2433223456 assigned to Leah Torres.

Ethan Wu: Also capture qualitative feedback: three quick questions post-session (was integration clear? blockers? next steps?). We'll log answers to account timeline.

Leah Torres: Good call. I'll include survey link in follow-up. Sending outreach now. :rocket:

Priya Desai: If they ask for immediate cost relief, offer delayed invoice net-60 or voucher, not price change. Keeps contract intact.

Leah Torres: Outreach sent. Putting customer reply below when I get it. :iphone:
